label: Weekend of Nov 6–8
next: Next weekend's preview (Nov 13–15) goes up Wednesday, after MHR posts its new ratings.

summary: Woodbridge Wolfpack (#4, 97.16 → now #6, 96.79): the weekend's biggest stumble. Went 2-2, with upset losses to East Coast Militia National (#51, 92.14) 3-2 and Atlantic Coast Academy (#25, 93.97) 4-0. Shutouts of Neponset (#22) and Providence Capitals Elite (#95) weren't enough to hold their spot.
East Coast Militia National (#51 → #47) were the giant-killers: they beat Woodbridge, Neponset (#22) 5-4 and ACA (#25) 5-3.

Edina (not in MHR's rankings yet, live 96.06) won the CCM World Invite 2012 Vizion at 6-0 with five shutouts, beating OMGHA (live 94.78) 5-3 in the final. OMGHA knocked out the Chicago Reapers (#17) 5-4 in the quarterfinals and Milwaukee (#47) 4-3 in the semis.
Team Illinois (#5 → #4) and Chicago Mission (#6 → #5, 96.98) moved up a spot each without playing, because Woodbridge dropped.
Biggby Coffee (#19 → #18, 94.96) went 3-0, including 8-1 over Fox Motors (#29). NJ Rockets (#15, 95.92) beat CT Jr Rangers National (#35) 8-0.
Shattuck St Mary's (#2, 99.63) went 3-0 against Upper Canada College by a combined 27-1, as expected.

Team Illinois (#53, 87.24 → now #45, 87.81) won the CCM World Invite 2013 Tacks as a big underdog. They beat Team Maryland (#34), Indiana Elite in the quarterfinal, Music City (#28) 4-2 in the semi and Windy City Storm (#22) 4-2 in the final.
Chicago Mission (#12, 91.19 → now #9, 91.33) went 4-1 and outscored opponents 26-5. They beat Team Maryland 6-0 in the quarterfinal, then lost the semifinal 2-1 to Windy City (#22).
Windy City Storm (#22 → #23) upset HB Detroit (#23) and Mission to reach the CCM final, but lost 4-2 to Team Illinois.
Chicago Reapers (#1, 95.13 → 94.97) went 3-0-2 at the 216 Showcase and stay #1, but ties with Syracuse (#7) and Anaheim (#3) cost them a little rating. Syracuse (#7) moved up to 93.08.

events.name: 216 Showcase – 2013 Elite
events.result: Field: Chicago Reapers, Anaheim, Little Caesars, Mid-Fairfield, Syracuse, Cleveland, Nor'easters, Columbus

summary: Chicago Reapers (#19, 95.22 → now #18, 95.30) went 3-1, but their 6-3 loss to Lehigh Valley Phantoms (#35, 93.03) was the upset of the weekend.
Florida Alliance (#4, 98.63 → 98.41) tied Pittsburgh Penguins Elite (#10) 3-3, which cost them some rating.
Indiana Elite (#26 → #28) went 3-2, losing 6-0 to the Reapers and 1-0 to London Jr Knights.
Ohio Blue Jackets (#24 → #23) split with Belle Tire (#42), losing 6-5 and then winning 6-0. North Jersey Avalanche (#12) beat Washington (#109) 7-0 and 13-2.
Little Caesars (#1, 95.26 → 94.97) are still #1 but went 2-1-1: they lost 5-1 to Pittsburgh Penguins Elite (#2) and tied Florida Surf (#14) 4-4.
Florida Surf (#14, 91.64 → 91.85) were the spoiler. They beat Penguins Elite (#2) 2-1 and Mid-Fairfield Elite (#6) 4-2, then tied Little Caesars.
Mid-Fairfield Elite (#6 → now #4, 93.42) beat Penguins Elite twice (2-0 and 6-2) and lost 5-4 to Little Caesars.
Chicago Mission (#7, 92.63 → now #9, 92.48) dropped two spots after an upset 6-4 loss to Vegas (#30, 89.58). They bounced back to beat Woodbridge (#45) 8-1 and Queen City (#59) 6-1.
Biggby Coffee (#13 → #12) went 5-0. Victory Honda (#23 → #20) beat St Louis (#10, now #13) 6-4 and Florida Surf 4-1.
